subject: KBD Lifecycle — the Prometheus skill pack's development process (kbd-assess, kbd-analyze, kbd-plan, kbd-execute, kbd-reflect, kbd-evolve)

sources.content_summary: Progress signaling is mandatory. First action every kbd-* turn: read position-reminder.txt. Emit 'Starting kbd-X — <phase> (step N of T)' before any tool call. N and T come from progress.json — never estimate. Emit 'Completed' signal after last action.

KBD lifecycle: kbd-new-phase → kbd-assess → (kbd-analyze) → kbd-plan → kbd-execute → kbd-reflect → (kbd-evolve). Each stage gates on the previous stage's handoff. The assess stage cannot be skipped. The analyze stage is optional. Reflect requires all changes DONE.

kbd-assess produces assessment.md. It reads the active phase's goals, inspects the codebase, and writes a gap report. It does NOT write skill files or plan content. It halts at the assess→plan boundary for explicit approval.

kbd-plan reads assessment.md and produces plan.md with an ordered change list. It detects OpenSpec (openspec/ directory) and emits changes in OpenSpec format. After plan.md is written, it writes the execute handoff. It does NOT execute any changes.

kbd-execute reads plan.md, writes execution.md, and applies changes in order. Per completed change: run artifact-refiner QA gate (if ≥3 files modified, not docs-only). Archive via /opsx:verify → /opsx:archive for OpenSpec changes. Updates progress.json after each change.

kbd-reflect produces reflection.md. It requires all changes DONE in progress.json. It reports goal achievement (MET/PARTIAL/NOT MET per goal), technical debt, lessons, and a recommended next phase. It passes through sycophancy-correction (the reflector sycophancy gate).

kbd-new-phase creates a new phase directory with goals.md and progress.json. It flips current-waypoint.json to the new phase. It fires phase:before hook. It does NOT run assess — the operator must run /kbd-assess after.

OpenSpec (openspec/ directory) is the change management backend. Changes are tracked as openspec/changes/<change-id>/proposal.md and tasks.md. Status values: PROPOSED → IN_PROGRESS → DONE → ARCHIVED. kbd-plan emits /opsx:new commands to create changes. kbd-execute uses /opsx:apply via /kbd-apply.

current-waypoint.json is the position record. It contains: phase, stage, changes_total, changes_completed, next_pending_change, exact_next_command. position-reminder.txt is a human-readable summary read as the FIRST tool call every turn. Both must be updated after every change completes.

Hooks fire at lifecycle boundaries: phase:before, phase:after, assess:before, assess:after, plan:before, plan:after, execute:before, execute:after, reflect:before, reflect:after. Hooks are sourced from shared/lib/hooks.sh. The reflector sycophancy gate is a SubagentStop hook.

The reflector gate runs sycophancy-correction on reflection.md before it is logged. A reflection that scores ≥0.4 sycophancy or has high/critical severity patterns is REJECTED. After 2 consecutive rejections, the third attempt is accepted with a logged warning. A passing reflection resets the counter.

Code-generation agents may not edit existing tests/steps/*.steps.ts, tests/support/*.ts, or tests/features/*.feature files to make failing tests pass. They must surface failing tests to the user. New .feature files may be added to tests/features/drafts/.

kbd-plan does NOT write skill files, code, or substrate. It only produces plan.md and emits OpenSpec change proposals (proposal.md + tasks.md). All code and skill files are written during kbd-execute.

When an openspec/ directory is present at the project root, OpenSpec IS the change management backend. It is not optional — kbd-plan detects it automatically and emits all changes in OpenSpec format. Ignoring OpenSpec breaks traceability.

progress.json is NOT updated automatically. It must be explicitly updated by the executing agent after each change completes (changes_completed++, active_change updated, next_pending_change advanced). Failure to update leaves the waypoint stale and breaks resume.

sources.source_ref: MISCONCEPTION: /kbd-reflect can run before all changes are DONE
sources.content_summary: kbd-reflect requires ALL changes to have status DONE in progress.json. Running it before completion produces a reflection that misrepresents the phase outcomes. The stage gate (kbd_stage_gate reflect) will reject early execution.

Reading position-reminder.txt is the FIRST tool call of every turn on any kbd-* skill. It is mandatory. Skipping it causes progress signals to be inaccurate (wrong N of T). N and T must come from progress.json, not from memory.

kbd-assess produces assessment.md ONLY — it does not write plan.md, skill files, or any implementation artifacts. It halts at the assess→plan boundary and requires explicit user approval before /kbd-plan is run.
